name: AI Object Removal
description: Paint over an object and LaMa inpaints the background. Runs offline once the 198 MB model is downloaded. The result must be accepted before it is saved as a derivative.
author: Pigeon
source: LaMa (Suvorov et al.), ONNX export by Carve
privacy: Only the model file is downloaded, once. Images are processed locally and never sent anywhere.
